parsed_json.up: Select the ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for distinct compounds tested in human assays against human amine oxidase B (flavin-containing). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, filtering by target name and assay organism. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Return columns named compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
